decision: No useful incremental billing-digit signal demonstrated by this fixed probe; no fullfit or online recommendation.
interpretation: All observed positive amounts are integral, so displayed monetary precision itself is constant. Lastdigit and round100 vary but true-digit model is worse than matched magnitude control on accuracy and logloss; worse accuracy than one stratified shuffled-digit control. Real-vs-shuffled LL difference alone does not establish beneficial signal.
limitations: One negative-control permutation is not a significance test.
Conditional magnitude controls are finite, not exact conditioning on all amounts.
Same development labels reused adaptively; no claim billing digits are universally uninformative.
Do not select individual digits, reroute slices, vary regularization, or call this a data ceiling.
